a detailed analysis of the structure of photon echoes, generated by sequences with few-cycle pulses.
the influence of pulse shape and pulse duration on the echo profile.
the development of new methods for the analysis of the structure of photon echo signals.

the photon echo signal is a complex, multi-component phenomenon that depends on the excitation pulse parameters.

we have demonstrated that a two-frequency character of the echo signal is a universal property of the system under excitation by few-cycle pulses.

the photon echo signals are determined by the spectral properties of the excitation pulses and are independent on the spectral properties of a medium, which is excited by the pulses.

a long-lived echo signal is generated by a sequence of pulses with different carrier frequencies, which is in contrast with the well-known fact that a long-lived photon echo is generated by a single pulse.
